title: Three Mondays and One Short Basket
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：kind　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kind 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the shopkeeper ① did the kind that no traveller in the doorway would have recorded, and he said the doing was the whole of the Monday. The ② kind, meaning the act itself and not the basket, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kind, he said, is the only thing in a doorway that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind in that doorway had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ kind at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to give and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kind, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the shopkeeper said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kind was the whole of the matter, meaning the goodness and not the act. The ⑥ kind, meaning the goodness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kind, he said, is either something you do or the only word that means both an act and a goodness. He said the goodness is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ kind had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ kind of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in December, was one doorway and three Mondays of recording; kind, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kind I remember is the act recorded in the note, which closed in 1972 and is still recorded as the quietest in the doorway. A ⑩ kind, my mother said in 1974, is the only act that improves by being recorded; every kind, she said, is a goodness that has agreed to look like an act. She said the goodness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 善意；善举（指门洞里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 善意；善举（指那次善行本身，与篮子相对）
C. 固定搭配：do the kind 做这件善事
D. n. 善意；善举（指留给孩子们送的一份那一次）
E. n. 为善之事（抽象总称，指一处门洞的善意之事）
F. n. 善意；善举（指便条里写到、被记下的的那一次）
G. n. 善良、厚道（指一件事里人人都行却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 厚道（抽象总称，指人人都行却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: did the kind that no traveller in the doorway would have recorded
The kind, meaning the act itself and not the basket
the kind at the far window
the kind was the whole of the matter
the kind had become a line in a note
The kind of the whole thing
A kind, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: do the kind 意为“做这件善事”，1965 年那位店主把门洞里没有一位赶路人肯记录的一次善举做了一遍。
kind 意为“善意；善举”，指那次善行本身而不是篮子，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。
kind 意为“善意；善举”，指门洞里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一只小小的篮子。
kind 意为“善意；善举”，指最远那扇窗台留给孩子们送的一份那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kind 意为“善良、厚道”，指一件事里人人都行却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份善良就是那件事的全部。
kind 意为“厚道”，指人人都行却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次善行，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kind 意为“善意；善举”，指便条里写到、被记下的的那一次，到 1970 年这一次成了便条里的一行。
kind 意为“为善之事”，店主十二月写道，整件事的善意之事是一处门洞和三个星期一的记录。
kind 意为“善意；善举”，我记得的是便条里记录过的那一次，1972 年传开了，至今仍被说成门洞里最安静的一次。
kind 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，善意是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的善行。
